title: Three brooms sweep the floor

source.why_this_clip: A straw broom fills the lower centre of the frame with its handle running up to the top edge, and it sweeps back and forth across a dark floor while a white apron stays at the left. The clip has no detected cuts, and from 4.5 s to 7.0 s the broom head stays large and in view before it swings out of frame at 7.25 s.

source_selection.evidence: Sixteen raw samples show three brooms in one continuous sweep; main bristles staylarge and visible. No cut/dissolve inside4.5–7.0. Retained endpoint slightly shortened to the final frozen vector observation; no pose extrapolation.

assembly_summary: Seventeen native strokes describe the main straw broom. Two separately moving background brooms are preserved from the frozen source-observed scene, all native copies. The moving apron/operator is omitted, not treated as stationary extracted geometry.
review_note: Bounded repair after independent still critique: Scale and place only the two pale secondary broom exposures to observed head widths and right-edge/low-edge crops. The main17native bristle/handle strokes and their sweep remain bit-identical. Fresh review pending; normal-speed playback/classifier/contacts remain unrun. No training ran.
